title: Security engagements
description: Penetration tests, assessments and incident response work, from scoping to closure.

notFound.title: Engagement not found
notFound.description: It may have been removed, or you are not a member of it.

list.emptyDescription: Engagements you lead or are a member of appear here.

form.newDescription: Record the client, the scope and who authorised the work. Assets, team and findings are added on the engagement page.
form.codeHint: Generated automatically. You can change it, but it must be unique.
form.title: Title
form.projectHint: Optional. Links the engagement to a delivery project for reference.
form.rulesHint: Testing windows, contacts, exclusions, escalation path and any constraints agreed with the client.
form.authorisationHint: An engagement can only be marked authorised once the person who approved it and the date are recorded. The signed letter is uploaded from the engagement page.

overview.deleteDescription: Only engagements still in scoping can be deleted. Assets and team members are removed with it.

status.cancelDescription: A cancelled engagement keeps its records but cannot move forward again.

team.emptyDescription: Members see the engagement, its assets, findings and reports.

scope.emptyDescription: List every authorised target: applications, hosts, networks, cloud accounts or identities.
scope.name: Name
scope.identifierHint: URL, IP address, CIDR range, account id or package name.
scope.deleteDescription: Findings linked to it will keep their details but lose the asset reference.

findings.emptyDescription: Findings are internal. They are never shown to the client; the client receives the final report.
findings.deleteDescription: Evidence files attached to it are removed as well.

form.title: Title
form.evidenceSummaryHint: Describe what proves the issue. Files are attached after saving.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.emptyDescription: Screenshots, request logs and proof of concept files stay private to the engagement team.
evidence.caption: Caption
evidence.captionHint: Optional. Defaults to the file name.

reports.emptyDescription: Upload report versions here. Finalise a version to freeze it, then share it with the client.
reports.finaliseDescription: A final report cannot be replaced or edited. Upload a new version for corrections.
reports.uploadHint: PDF only. This upload will be recorded as version {n}.
reports.title: Report title
